name: observability-readonly
description: Read-only harvest of a live Prometheus + Grafana + otel-collector stack: running Prometheus config/targets/rules (witnessed renderings), instant PromQL reads, Grafana datasource/dashboard inventory (credentials deep-redacted), and the collector's as-deployed config file. Read-only by construction — no reload/apply/write/admin tool exists on this surface; Prometheus's lifecycle endpoint is never proxied. Phase-4 promstack validation rig.

tools.name: get_prometheus_config
tools.description: The RUNNING Prometheus configuration as the server reports it (/api/v1/status/config) plus its witnessed config-file path (/api/v1/status/flags --config.file).

tools.name: get_scrape_targets
tools.description: Active scrape targets: job, instance, health, lastError (lean fields).

tools.name: query_metric
tools.description: Instant PromQL query (read-only, <=512 chars, result capped at 50 series).

tools.name: get_grafana_datasources
tools.description: Provisioned Grafana datasources, credentials deep-redacted by key.

tools.name: get_grafana_dashboard
tools.description: One dashboard's full JSON model by uid (as-provisioned artifact).

tools.name: get_otel_config
tools.description: The otel-collector config AS DEPLOYED (read-only file mount; the collector has no config API).
